conflicting_normative_claims.claim: media_runs requires track=v4 and track=vnext with real rendered media, v4_vnext_comparison on the same scene_digest, vnext_runtime_binding to vec/projection/run/result records. The acceptance gate presumes the vNext track can be rendered from vNext outputs.
The CLI exposes only session/shadow/text-shadow and is documented 'never production delivery'; no command derives storyboard/video-prompt delivery from a run.

Delivery adapters require capability_profile_digest(profile) == ProjectionManifest.capability_profile_digest. The manifest records the GenerationCapabilityProfile (duration) digest, while adapters accept only the delivery CapabilityProfile digest; the two types cannot match. Default invocation fails closed (verified: DomainValidationError 'delivery CapabilityProfile digest must match the ProjectionManifest').

reproducible_findings.finding: No project entrypoint generates storyboard/video-prompt delivery from run artifacts. Only four CLI-capable modules exist (cli.py, release_control.py, rebuild_control.py, baseline_audit_control.py); none derives delivery.
reproducible_findings.evidence: full-repo search for argparse/ArgumentParser and command registration

reproducible_findings.finding: Default adapter chain is broken: derive_video(ast) succeeds, but render_video(projection, profile) without explicit capability binding raises DomainValidationError because the manifest digest (duration capability profile 0884044b...) and the delivery CapabilityProfile digest never match.
reproducible_findings.evidence: executed against projection_ast artifact b7031e93... of run a10-live-vnext-shadow-ep35-20260803

reproducible_findings.finding: No Markdown renderer exists over the v3.1 structured delivery (StoryboardPanel/VideoPromptChunk). The V5.2/V5.4 Golden renderers (storyboard_renderer.py, video_renderer.py) consume the v5-era DualOutputContract, not ProjectionAST; nothing bridges them.
reproducible_findings.evidence: storyboard_renderer.py / video_renderer.py import mode_p_vnext.storyboard_projection only; git history single commit e97805f

consequence.statement: A10 requires the owner to render the vNext track as real media, but the vNext system provides no legitimate path from run artifacts to renderable storyboard/video prompts. The acceptance gate therefore presumes a capability that no A-package delivered. The owner cannot produce the required media through the project; only an external patch (driver script calling derive_*/render_* with an explicit capability binding plus a locally authored markdown layout) can produce render input, and that patch is not a project capability.
consequence.not_a_runtime_crash: This is not a runtime failure; it is an acceptance-design gap: the A-series scope validated evidence-chain correctness (TEXT_VALIDATED, AST compilation, DP review) but never validated the delivery output path, while A10's media gate assumes it exists.

temporary_mitigation_applied.what_it_does: loads the run's projection_ast artifact, rebuilds the canonical ProjectionAST, calls official derive_storyboard/derive_video and render_storyboard/render_video with an explicit delivery CapabilityProfile binding (the documented-but-never-wired path), and formats the structured delivery into Chinese markdown. Content is 100% AST-sourced; only layout and tick->seconds conversion are local.
temporary_mitigation_applied.explicit_limitation: The driver and its outputs are patch artifacts, not project capabilities. They must not be recorded as vNext project delivery capability in any acceptance evidence.

owner_decision.consequence: A10 remains in MEDIA_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED. No vNext-track media is rendered until a v3.2 delivery package (run-artifact to delivery CLI, markdown renderers, digest contract repair, real-run acceptance test) is planned and authorized. Patch artifacts remain in the run directory as evidence of the gap and its temporary mitigation, explicitly not a project capability.

owner_decisions_required.description: Use the patched render input (explicitly labeled as patch, content AST-sourced) to render the vNext track and complete the A10 media comparison. The comparison then measures director design quality (AST content), not vNext system delivery capability.
owner_decisions_required.note: keeps A10 moving; the gap evidence remains open for v3.2

owner_decisions_required.description: Hold A10 in MEDIA_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED and add a v3.2 work package that implements the delivery path (CLI command + markdown renderer + digest contract repair) before any vNext-track media is required.
owner_decisions_required.note: cleanest architecture outcome; stalls the final release gate

owner_decisions_required.description: Change the A10 media gate to require only the v4 track plus vNext text evidence, dropping the dual-track media comparison until the delivery package exists.
owner_decisions_required.note: requires architecture authority change to the release ledger, owner decision

resolution_required.successor: v3.1 -> v3.2 rebase must add a bounded delivery-package covering: (a) run-artifact to delivery CLI, (b) markdown renderers over the v3.1 structured delivery, (c) repair of the delivery CapabilityProfile digest contract so the documented default path works, (d) an A-series acceptance test that renders delivery output from a real run artifact.
